task: Blind reproduction of the claims below from raw CSVs (raw/, XT_RAW_DIR) and drive_master.csv; do not read tools/capacity_anchors.py. Definitions are in analyses/M699_spec.md section 11 (Rev 1) only.

definitions.pair: consecutive canonical-clean drives k,k+1 (ens_outlier_v2 False), parked gap before k and before k+1 each >= 2 h (clock times + file-name date, gap = next key-on minus (key-on + duration)); excluded if next-drive unlogged_distance_est_km > 1 in seasonal_drive_master.csv, if drive k current coverage (integrated segments with gaps<=10 s / current span) < 0.95, or |SoC_first(k+1)-SoC_first(k)| < 10 points; SoC_first = median of first 3 SoC samples >0; Ah = trapezoid integral of current (A, sign: positive = SoC rising) over segments of drive k
definitions.E2: 100*sum(Q_k*dS)/sum(dS^2) with dS = SoC_first(k+1)-SoC_first(k); day-clustered percentile bootstrap, seed 42, 4000 draws over calendar days
definitions.E2_withinDrive: same with dS = SoC_last(k)-SoC_first(k), SoC_last = median of last 3 SoC samples

gapReestimate.note: SoC change across the parked gap (BMS rest re-estimate); parked current is assumed zero (no logger while parked)

keyOnCurrentA.note: median of the first 5 current samples of each drive; the HV battery carries an auxiliary load at key-on, so a key-on voltage is not a rest voltage when this share is small

claims.E1: no drive has >=120 s of key-on samples with |I|<=1 A before any |I|>1 A sample (nAnchorsWithVoltageWindow = 0)
claims.E3: per-quarter M403-style B_primary not part of this audit; only check quarter drive/day counts: {"2026Q2": [91, 25], "2026Q3": [388, 76], "2026Q4": [174, 26]}
